newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,928 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,928 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,928 contracts compared with 1,265 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 161 wheat, 406 corn, 1,137 soybean, 199 soymeal, 19 soyoil, five wheat calls and one corn call traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent up to 1/2 cent lower, corn was 1/4 cent lower to 2-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 11-1/4 to 3-1/2 cents higher.
